caption: How to deal with anxiety. Part 1. More tomorrow. #usahealth #wellness #wellnessjourney #selflove #anxiety
transcript: Your anxiety is not in your mind, it's in your heart. The ancients called it fire without direction. It rises, faster than you can follow. Thoughts scatter, the chest tightens, sleep will not come. This is not madness, it is imbalance. Too much fire, too little water. You cannot silence fire by force. You must invite it to rest. Place one hand on your heart, one hand on your belly. Breathe in through the nose for four, breathe out through the mouth for six. With every breath, imagine a cool stream flowing from your heart down to your belly. Fire returns to warmth, water returns to stillness. Peace is not the absence of heat, it is the balance of warmth and calm. The full ritual, the breath, the tea, the words to say before sleep, is in my book, Healing the Modern Soul.
